question.text: Board approval process for a new Cat III AIF investment strategy change:

answer.text: Needs consent of at least two-thirds of unit holders by value

explanation.text: The Logic: Change in investment strategy requires two-thirds consent of investors by value (Topic 4). The Trap: Other thresholds don't match SEBI norms. Cross-Exam Context: Governance-level decision. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Plan investor communication 90+ days before proposed strategy change vote.
